subject: Portal Enrollment & PO Acceptance Requirements for Pinegrove Energy
messages:
From: Sophie Lee <sophie.lee@pinegrove.energy>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-10-02T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor enrollment / PO acceptance details request

Hi Mateo / Laura,

We're starting vendor onboarding for Redwood so our AP team can accept your invoices and PO numbers cleanly. Can you share your vendor registration checklist and the list of required documents we need to collect? A few specifics our team needs to confirm: 

- Legal entity and tax ID to appear on invoices (we need exact matches for our PO matching).
- Is W-9 sufficient for US entities, and do you have an EU VAT certificate for EU billing?
- Remit information: do you prefer bank upload to portal, encrypted email, or DocuSign EFT mandate?
- Invoice format we should accept: PDF with PO reference, or do you support e-invoice (Peppol/SFTP/JSON)?
- Any required PO field patterns (e.g., 7-digit numeric only) for 2-way PO matching.

We prefer to have the vendor fully set up one week before the first invoice. I attached our vendor profile request PDF to get started.

Thanks,
Sophie
Sophie Lee
Senior Procurement Specialist
Pinegrove Energy

Attachment: Pinegrove_vendor_profile_request.pdf

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.inference>
To: Sophie Lee <sophie.lee@pinegrove.energy>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-10-02T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment / PO acceptance details request

Hi Sophie — great to connect, and thanks for the checklist. Short answers up front, and I've attached our AP packet for the onboarding flow.

- Legal entity: "Redwood Inference, Inc." (we'll provide exact tax ID on the form).
- For US: W-9 is fine. For EU invoices we'll provide the VAT registration certificate where applicable.
- Preferred remit: EFT via completed EFT mandate (DocuSign is fine). We can also accept bank file uploads through your portal if that's simpler.
- Invoice format: PDF invoices with PO reference work for now; we also support e-invoice via SFTP or Peppol for higher-volume programs.
- PO matching: Our system supports up to 16-digit alphanumeric PO numbers but we map strictly to the PO number field. If your AP requires only numeric pattern, let us know and we'll provide mapping guidance.

Attached: redwood_ap_onboarding_packet_v1.pdf, W9-template.pdf — Laura from Finance is copied and will fill the supplier profile and the EFT mandate.

Next steps:
1) Laura will send our completed supplier profile + EFT mandate.
2) You confirm the PO pattern (example PO + portal test).
3) We will upload our vendor record to your portal and run a test invoice.

If Pinegrove has any SFTP/Peppol endpoints or EDI specs, please share them.

Thanks — Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
redwood.inference

Attachments: redwood_ap_onboarding_packet_v1.pdf, W9-template.pdf

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
To: Sophie Lee <sophie.lee@pinegrove.energy>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-10-03T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment / PO acceptance details request

Hi Sophie — thanks. I've completed our supplier profile and the EFT mandate; attaching both here. A couple of items for your AP team to confirm: 

- Payment terms: Redwood's standard is Net 45, but Finance can accept Net 30 if Pinegrove needs that for this supplier. Let us know which you'd prefer for the first 3 invoices.
- PO numbering: please confirm whether PO numbers will always include the prefix "PG-" or if they will be numeric only. That affects our PO mapping configuration.
- Tax ID: we'll include a signed W-9 in the supplier profile. For EU invoices we will provide VAT certs as required.

We're happy to push a test invoice once our vendor record is provisioned on your portal.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Corporate Controller | Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_supplier_profile_filled.pdf, redwood_eft_mandate.pdf

From: Sophie Lee <sophie.lee@pinegrove.energy>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-10-04T15:50:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment / PO acceptance details request

Hi Laura / Mateo — thanks for the quick turnaround. A few updates from AP: 

- We've provisioned Redwood on our vendor portal; registration shows as "submitted". Portal link: https://vendor.pinegrove.energy/portal/register/6419923
- Pinegrove accepts PDF invoices with PO reference for now (we prefer PDF + PO in header). We also accept Peppol if you enroll with our gateway; see portal for the e-invoice option.
- PO pattern for this program is numeric only, 7 digits (example: 6419923). Please ensure the PO sent on the invoice matches exactly.
- Attached is the official PO for your test invoice (PO-6419923.pdf).

Please send your test invoice with the PO number in the invoice header and tax ID in the tax id field. Once we validate, we'll flip to active and schedule payment per agreed terms.

Regards,
Sophie Lee
Senior Procurement Specialist
Pinegrove Energy

Attachment: PO-6419923.pdf

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.inference>
To: Sophie Lee <sophie.lee@pinegrove.energy>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-10-05T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment / PO acceptance details request

Thanks Sophie — good to see the portal flow moving. We'll proceed with the test invoice today. Quick confirmations before we submit: 

- We will use invoice reference: INV-RED-20271005-001 and put PO number 6419923 in the PO field exactly as provided.
- Tax ID and W-9 will be embedded in the PDF header and included as a separate attachment if your portal requires it.
- EFT mandate signed and returned to your portal this morning.

We'll submit the test invoice to ap@pinegrove.energy and reply to this thread with the tracking ID. If everything validates on your end, please mark vendor as active so future invoices route into normal payment queue.

HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/contact/PE-1129

Cheers,
Mateo Alvarez
Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachment (to be sent): INV-RED-20271005-001.pdf
